query: WITH HouseholdMembers AS (SELECT e.head_of_household_id, e.wealth_level, COUNT(d.id) AS member_count FROM estishraf_llm_wealth_index AS e JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala AS d ON e.head_of_household_id = d.head_of_household_id WHERE d.person_status = 'صالح' AND d.death_date IS NULL GROUP BY e.head_of_household_id, e.wealth_level) SELECT wealth_level, AVG(member_count) AS average_household_size, COUNT(*) AS household_count FROM HouseholdMembers GROUP BY wealth_level ORDER BY CASE wealth_level WHEN 'Poor' THEN 1 WHEN 'Lower Middle' THEN 2 WHEN 'Middle' THEN 3 WHEN 'Upper Middle' THEN 4 WHEN 'Rich' THEN 5 END LIMIT 1200
